name: overhead-squat-barbell
title: Overhead Squat: Barbell
primer: In this version of the squat you hold the bar overhead as you perform the exercise.
steps: Stand with your feet a bit wider than shoulder width apart with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Grasp a barbell using a wide snatch grip with your arms and elbows fully extended.
Keeping the bar overhead, bend your knees and lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor.
tips: Keep your feet firmly planted on the floor throughout this exercise.
Keep your abs drawn in, your back tight and your chest up as you perform this exercise.
